notes.title: Meteoric VR - Early Access Version Update 1.2.0 on App Lab!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555399/febe96171535085dced8783d166479175b9965f8.png[/img]

Greetings Superheroes! 

We hope you’ve enjoyed Meteoric VR - Early Access so far! We are now ready to roll out some more new updates! As you may know, [url=https://developer.oculus.com/blog/hand-tracking-improvements-v2-1/]Meta Quest has introduced the latest hand tracking update[/url] less than 2 weeks ago. We wanted to make use of this new technology and push Meteoric VR forward with this update making use of the v2.1 update and much more!

[url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/4128981423869367/]Meteoric VR - Early Access Version Update 1.2.0 on App Lab[/url]

- Updated hand-tracking SDK to [url=https://developer.oculus.com/blog/hand-tracking-improvements-v2-1/]v2.1[/url].
- Each ability can be upgraded.
- Added challenges (3 levels).
- Visualized player's hit (cracked helmet).
- New wormhole and meteor trails VFX.

[b]Laser Upgrades[/b]

- Level 1 - Damage 1.
- Level 2 - Damage 2.
- Level 3 - Multi-hit, laser is not stopped with the first hit.

[b]Shield Upgrades[/b]

- Level 1 - Small shield.
- Level 2 - Large shield.
- Level 3 - Deflect UFO projectiles.

[b]Energy Ball Upgrades[/b]

- Level 1 - More time to charge, short fire time.
- Level 2 - Short charge time.
- Level 3 - Long fire time.

We hope that you continue enjoying Meteoric VR to the fullest with the new update and look forward to future ones! Don’t forget to check out our socials and communities [url=https://linktr.ee/meteoric_vr]here![/url]

- The Meteoric VR Team

notes.title: The Meteoric VR Demo Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
Attention all Superheroes!

We are so excited to announce our next demo update is now live! We hope that you have enjoyed our demo so far, we felt that it was time to add in some new features for you to enjoy. You can now look out for all the customised crystals, each one with their own power ups!

[h3]With this update:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The planet now has 3 lives which are shown as 3 hearts on the gameplay HUD.
[*] Crystals have been changed from cubes to models representing the power-up.
[*] Added gold coin crystal which is randomly spawned in a level, and can be used in the shop.
[*] Players can now buy skins and weapons in the shop for coins.
[*] Added health crystals which replenish 1 heart when picked up.
[*] Meteors are now also spawned from wormholes.
[*] Updated hand tracking v2 on Oculus.
[/list]
[h3]Beta Access[/h3]

If you are really enjoying Meteoric VR and want to give your feedback on new features, gameplay updates, and more, join us on discord, where you can gain access to the beta version of the game. Any and all feedback you can provide us helps us make the game even better, and we are grateful to everyone who has beta tested Meteoric VR so far!

That’s all for now Superheroes! You can find the steam demo link and links to our social media below!

[b]Join the Discord Community for Beta Access and More!:[/b] https://discord.gg/KSr8rDuhEF

[b]Play the New Demo!
